newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takeda Chem hits year high in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Takeda Chem hits year high in afternoon.

text.p: Shares of Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd hit their year high of 2,060 yen on Friday afternoon due to institutional investor buying, brokers said.
The shares last hit that level on September 18.
As of 0500 GMT, the shares stood at 2,060 yen, up 30 yen. They rose as high as 2,070 yen at one point. Turnover stood at 1.235 million shares.
Brokers said Takeda, along with Sankyo Co Ltd, is a major pharmaceutical issue which is included in most investor portfolios.
